## Checklist

- [ ] CI is green (validate, components, a11y, interactions, duplicates, mobile)
- [ ] Looks right in its own theme plus two others, light and dark, at desktop and 360px width
- [ ] Copy is specific to the trade (names, prices, hours), not lorem or buzzwords
- [ ] Original work with placeholder content only (no real logos, brands or copied designs), contributed under the project licence (see CONTRIBUTING)
- [ ] Screenshot or short recording attached

Reviewers: see [REVIEWING.md](../REVIEWING.md).
